metadata.description: Validation test for the GPS-RESCUE failsafe procedure (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T10): about 70 m out, the link is lost at 25 s. Stage 2 at 26.5 s starts GPS Rescue (mode !FS!); the link coming back at 40 s with centred sticks does not end it; a 40% roll stick at 45 s does, and the pilot has control again.
